1: # ADR 0009: IAM User Directory Pagination & Deterministic Concurrency, User Role Assignments with Expiry & Self-Lockout Protection, Profile-Aware Corporate Directory Lookup, Zero-Role Onboarding Ticket Port, and Formula-Safe CSV Access Review Exports
2: 
3: - **Date:** 2026-10-29
4: - **Status:** Proposed
5: 
6: <!-- An Accepted ADR stays. A later decision writes the next file and sets this line to "Superseded by ADR <NN>". Do not edit Decision or Alternatives after Accepted. -->
7: - **Deciders:** mdurana
8: 
9: ## Context
10: 
11: Story `P2-C` (`p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports`) completes the workforce access lifecycle, corporate directory lookup, self-service onboarding, and compliance access review export capabilities of the `com.example.app.iam` bounded context inside `app/backend/`. Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/iam-access-control.md`, `docs/agents-v0/network.md`, `ADR 0001` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0001-modular-monolith-architecture.md`), `ADR 0002` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0002-openapi-v1-contract-conventions.md`), `ADR 0003` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0003-iam-and-audit-persistence-isolation.md`), `ADR 0007` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0007-bff-oidc-fail-closed-session-auth.md`), and `ADR 0008` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0008-iam-rbac-sod-and-view-as.md`) establish six non-trivial architectural and security constraints:
12: 
13: 1. **User Directory Pagination, Filtering, Deterministic Optimistic Concurrency, and Immediate Session Revocation on Deactivation (`AC-1`, `AC-2`, `AC-7`, `AC-8`, `security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §11, VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10):**
14:    - `GET /api/v1/iam/users` (`listUsers`) must apply offset pagination (`page >= 1`, `limit` capped at `100`) and optional case-insensitive substring filtering (`search` up to `128` characters) across `workspace_email`, `dis
<truncated 2556 bytes>
 Violations write `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED` to `audit_log_entries` (`@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` per `L-004`) and return `HTTP 403 Forbidden` (`SOD_CONFLICT_DETECTED`).
22:    - Removed role assignments are never physically deleted; they are soft-revoked (`is_active = false`, `revoked_at = now()`) to preserve 13-month audit history (`V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql`), while newly granted or updated assignments are inserted/updated as active (`is_active = true`, `expires_at`), incrementing the user's concurrency version (`ETag`) and recording `IAM_USER_ROLES_UPDATED` in `audit_log_entries`.
23:    - Per `L-003` (`BoundedContextIsolationRules`), `com.example.app.iam.port` must expose a value-typed cross-context `IamRoleGrantPort` (`IamRoleGrantRequest`, `IamRoleGrantResult`) so downstream governance ticket approval workflows (`P2-M`) can grant approved `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` roles without importing internal `com.example.app.iam.{domain,repository}` classes.
24: 
25: 3. **Administrator Self-Lockout Protection (`AC-7`, `L-004`, `security-baseline.mdc` §2, §11, VAPT F4, F8, F10):**
26:    - An authenticated administrator must be prevented from locking themselves out of platform administration:
27:      1. Calling `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` with `isActive = false` where `id.equals(principal.userId())` (self-deactivation).
28:      2. Calling `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles` where `id.equals(principal.userId())` and the caller currently holds an active `ADMIN` role (`role_code = "ADMIN"`), if the proposed `assignments` list omits the `ADMIN` role or sets an expired/missing active `ADMIN` assignment (self-admin-role revocation).
29:    - Both conditions must be refused with RFC 7807 `HTTP 409 Conflict` (`errorCode = "SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED"`, `correlationId`) and synchronously record an immutable `audit_log_entries` row (`event_type = "IAM_SELF_LOCKOUT_REFUSED"`, `outcome = "DENIED"`) inside a `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` boundary per `L-004`.

90: - `auth` — Enforces administrator self-lockout protection (`SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED` when an administrator attempts to deactivate their own user account or remove/expire their own active `ADMIN` role), revokes active Redis sessions (`SessionStorePort`) and blocks authenticated access when a user is deactivated (`is_active = false`), and blocks all mutating calls under an active `View-As` overlay (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`) (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §11; VAPT F4, F8, F10).
91: - `any {id} path` — Exposes `GET /api/v1/iam/users/{id}`, `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}`, and `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles` requiring strict UUID path validation, `If-Match` optimistic concurrency enforcement (`HTTP 412` / `HTTP 409`), and self-lockout target ID comparison (`security-baseline.mdc` §2, §11; VAPT F4, F8).
92: - **Sensitive actions (for Design step-up / dual-control evaluation)**: Deactivating or reactivating a workforce user account (`PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}`), granting or revoking user roles (`PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles`), submitting a self-service role application ticket (`POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications`), and exporting workforce user and role/permission access review CSV reports (`GET /api/v1/iam/exports/users`, `GET /api/v1/iam/exports/roles`)—each requiring explicit authorization, `View-As` mutation blocking on state changes, optimistic concurrency (`If-Match`) or idempotency (`Idempotency-Key`), and synchronous immutable audit logging (`audit_log_entries`).
93: 
94: ## Regulations
95: 
96: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Access Controls)**: Mandates formal workforce access lifecycle governance (self-service `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` maker-checker onboarding, time-bounded role assignments via `expires_at`, immediate session termination upon user deactivation, administrator self-lockout prevention, `100%` production Segregation of Duties enforcement, and periodic user/role access review CSV exports).
97: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Governs corporate directory lookups (`GET /api/v1/iam/directory`), workforce user profile management (`workspace_email`, `display_name`, `department`), and user access review CSV exports (`GET /api/v1/iam/exports/users`), requiring least-privilege RBAC authorization and tamper-evident audit logging of every directory change and data export.
98: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §5, §7, §8, §11, §12 & VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10)**: Requires explicit operation-to-permission RBAC guards, server-side `View-As` mutation blocking (`VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`), CSV formula-injection neutralization on all exported CSV cells (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r`), strict `additionalProperties: false` schema validation on all request DTOs, `If-Match` / `Idempotency-Key` enforcement, Resilience4j circuit-breaker protection on outbound directory calls (`503 DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE`), and `Encode.forJava()` sanitization on all audit records.
